notes.cap: HEZE that can ever be issued across every deck; a unit of account inside the files, never a token
notes.awayHours: the most time a deck will catch up on when you come back
notes.secondsPerDay: how long a day is, in real seconds
notes.grant: HEZE the jarl starts with, credited against the cap
notes.price: HEZE per unit of each resource, at the docket
notes.pileBase: what each resource can hold with no pile built
notes.manaMax: the reserve the spells draw on
notes.manaPerDay: how much of the reserve comes back each day
notes.raidersStep: how much raid strength grows each step
notes.raidersEvery: days between steps of raid strength
notes.raidTake: share of a pile a raid takes when the ford is not held
notes.spoilPerStrength: spoil per point of your raiders' strength
notes.bronzePerDay: most bronze cast in a day
notes.bronzeHydrogenRatio: units of silicate per unit of hydrogen in a casting
